topics.topic: The A2A Protocol: Agent Cards and Cross-Vendor Handoff
topics.why: #1 prod protocol request (asked 3x) with zero library coverage; A2A is now the horizontal cross-vendor coordination standard complementing MCP.

topics.topic: The MCP + A2A Stack: Tools vs Agent Coordination
topics.why: Merges 3x A2A demand with multi-agent build demand into the 2026 enterprise-default two-layer architecture (MCP for tools, A2A for agents).

topics.topic: Customizing Claude Code: Subagents, Hooks, and CLAUDE.md
topics.why: Part of the 4x Claude Code/.claude customization cluster and a clean KB gap; teaches lifecycle hooks, forked subagents, and repo-constitution conventions.

topics.topic: Supervisor, Swarm, and Handoff: Choosing a Multi-Agent Topology
topics.why: Decision-focused answer to the recurring multi-agent-workflow ask (3x); covers the three production-surviving orchestration shapes, distinct from generic orchestration.

topics.topic: Context Engineering: The Discipline
topics.why: Context engineering replaced prompt engineering as the core 2026 agent-building skill; teaches what-belongs-in-the-window selection and the memory-vs-context framing.

topics.topic: Interleaved Thinking Between Tool Calls
topics.why: Reasoning-plus-tools models now think between tool calls, reshaping how multi-step agent loops are structured; a first-class 2026 agent feature not yet covered.

topics.topic: Turn Detection, Barge-in, and Latency Budgets for Voice Agents
topics.why: Voice support agents asked 2x; the conversational-UX layer (semantic turn detection, interruption handling, ~800ms budget) is where most voice prototypes break.

topics.topic: Building Agents with the Claude Agent SDK
topics.why: Claude Agent SDK asked 4x in prod with a clean KB gap; teaches production harness primitives (subagents, sessions, hooks) beyond raw API calls.

topics.topic: Claude Skills: Portable Filesystem Capabilities (SKILL.md)
topics.why: Part of the 4x Claude cluster and a distinct portable capability format; SKILL.md packages load on demand across Claude Code and the Agent SDK.

topics.topic: LangChain vs LangGraph: Chains, Graphs, and When to Use Each
topics.why: Explicit prod request for the head-to-head; clarifies the chain-vs-durable-graph decision the existing single-tool lessons never contrast directly.

topics.topic: Type-Safe Agents with Pydantic AI
topics.why: Pydantic AI V2 (stable June 2026) is the go-to for type-safe structured-output agents; a growing framework with no dedicated lesson.

topics.topic: Self-Improving Agents with DSPy and GEPA
topics.why: GEPA reflective prompt evolution (ICLR 2026 Oral) beats RL with 35x fewer rollouts; how teams now optimize agent prompts and tools from traces.

topics.topic: Build Evals for a Customer-Support Agent
topics.why: Directly requested in prod (evals for a customer-support app) inside the #1 uncovered eval cluster; end-to-end simulation + turn-level + tool-call scoring.

topics.topic: Trajectory and Tool-Call Evaluation for Agents
topics.why: Grading the path (tool selection, argument validity, step order) not just the answer is the core 2026 agent-eval skill and the top uncovered cluster.

topics.topic: Eval-Driven CI Gates for Agents
topics.why: CI-gating is the explicitly THIN angle in the KB-gap report; wires evals into GitHub Actions to block PRs on quality regression with pass@k thresholds.

topics.topic: pass@k and pass^k: Measuring Agent Consistency
topics.why: Foundational 2026 metric for non-deterministic agents (any-of-k vs all-k); a single teachable concept underpinning CI eval gates.

topics.topic: Debiasing and Calibrating LLM Judges
topics.why: Position/verbosity/self-preference bias and calibration drift on every judge swap now demand kappa/alpha agreement checks; extends LLM-as-Judge beyond basics.

topics.topic: Production-to-Eval Feedback Loop
topics.why: Converting failed production traces into eval cases grows golden sets from real behavior; a standard loop in the 2026 agent-eval stack.

topics.topic: Evaluating Voice Agents
topics.why: Voice support asked 2x; adds voice-specific metrics (WER, turn-latency p95, containment, barge-in correctness) not covered by text evals, within the top eval cluster.

topics.topic: Prompt and Prefix Caching for LLM Apps
topics.why: Direct prod request ('how prompt caching works in LLMs') with no lesson; prefix/KV caching is the highest-ROI cost lever for repeated agent system prompts.

topics.topic: Databases for Agentic Systems
topics.why: Direct prod request ('different databases in agentic systems'); teaches choosing across vector, graph, key-value, and relational stores for memory tiers.

topics.topic: Agent Sandboxes: Running Untrusted Agent Code Safely
topics.why: Coding/computer-use agents execute model-generated code; ephemeral microVM sandboxing (E2B, Firecracker, gVisor) is a core 2026 deployment skill.

topics.topic: Model Routing: Cascades and Cost-Aware Model Selection
topics.why: The ~100x cross-model price spread makes cascade/cost-aware routing the top production cost lever; increasingly governed infra with pre-merge eval gates.

topics.topic: MCP Registries and Server Discovery
topics.why: Teams now discover tools from the ~2,000-server MCP registry rather than hand-wiring them, making registry literacy a practical 2026 requirement.

topics.topic: Agentic RAG: Iterative Retrieve-Reason-Refine Loops
topics.why: Dominant 2026 production retrieval paradigm; directly serves the 7x RAG-build and 3x multi-agent-workflow demand by teaching agent-driven decompose/retrieve/judge/re-retrieve.

topics.topic: Contextual Retrieval: Chunk Augmentation Before Embedding
topics.why: Anthropic's contextual-retrieval trick still wins 2026 benchmarks (35-67% fewer failed retrievals) and pairs with the 4x-demanded Claude stack via prompt caching.

topics.topic: Retrieval as a Tool: Designing Search for Agents
topics.why: Leading 2026 agents treat retrieval as an agent-invoked tool (grep/search) not passive vector lookup; matches agent-tool-pattern and 'databases in agentic systems' demand.

topics.topic: Text-to-SQL for Agents: RAG Over Structured Data
topics.why: RAG over relational data via text-to-SQL maps to the prod request for 'different databases in agentic systems'; covers schema retrieval and self-correction.

topics.topic: Self-Correcting RAG: Retrieval Grading and Re-Retrieval
topics.why: Grading retrieved chunks and looping back on low relevance (CRAG/Self-RAG lineage) is a survive-production 2026 pattern that cuts hallucination in agentic pipelines.

topics.topic: The Lethal Trifecta and the Agents Rule of Two
topics.why: The dominant 2026 mental model for agent breaches (private data + untrusted content + external comms) plus Meta's concrete Rule-of-Two design constraint.

topics.topic: Securing A2A: Trust and Auth in Agent-to-Agent Protocols
topics.why: As A2A spreads (3x prod ask), cross-agent trust, delegated authorization, and injection propagation across handoffs become a new attack surface beyond single-agent tool security.

topics.topic: Securing MCP Servers: Tool Poisoning and Rug Pulls
topics.why: MCP hit ~97M downloads/month with 30%+ of registry servers carrying flaws; tool poisoning and post-approval rug pulls are the concrete new attack class.

topics.topic: Building an Agent Guardrail Stack (Llama Guard, NeMo, LLM Guard)
topics.why: 2026 guardrails are a multi-layer stack across input/output/tool-use, not one filter; teaches wiring classifier and Colang rails, extending the guardrails lesson.

topics.topic: Data Exfiltration Defenses for Agents (Zero-Click Leaks)
topics.why: Real zero-click exploits (EchoLeak in M365 Copilot, GeminiJack) show markdown-image and external-request leaks; blocking exfil vectors and CSP is now a required layer.

topics.topic: How Prompt and KV Caching Work
topics.why: Model-side mechanism behind the cost lever: KV cache, prefix reuse, PagedAttention — why repeated agent prefixes cache (complements the Infra ops lesson).

topics.topic: Reasoning Models and Test-Time Compute
topics.why: Every major lab now ships a reasoning tier that plans and self-checks; practitioners must learn when the token/latency cost is worth it.

topics.topic: Constrained Decoding and Grammar-Guided Generation
topics.why: FSM/grammar-based decoding is the 2026 production standard for reliable outputs; teaches the 'constraint tax' on tool calls below the JSON-Schema surface.

topics.topic: Distilling Agents from a Frontier Teacher
topics.why: Cloning a frontier agent's tool-use trajectories into a fine-tuned small model is the practical path to cheap specialized agents on a team's task distribution.

topics.topic: Build an A2A Agent with a Signed AgentCard
topics.why: A2A asked 3x with no build path; a hands-on lesson exposing a signed AgentCard and handling a delegated task turns the spec into a shippable skill.

topics.topic: Build a Voice Agent with the Realtime Speech-to-Speech API
topics.why: Voice customer-support agents requested 2x with no build lesson wiring a live speech-to-speech loop end to end.

topics.topic: Build a Customer-Support Agent with Tools and Escalation
topics.why: Customer-support agent builds appear 5x in prod (the top applied GAP); an end-to-end build with tool calls, knowledge lookup, and human escalation.

topics.topic: Streaming Agent Output with SSE and the Vercel AI SDK
topics.why: Streaming/SSE is an emerging clean KB gap; token + tool-part streaming is the baseline UX every 2026 agent app needs.

topics.topic: Build a Multi-Agent Workflow with Handoffs
topics.why: Multi-agent workflow builds asked 3x; a concrete supervisor + specialist-agents build with handoff, shared state, and result merging.

topics.topic: Build a Multimodal RAG App over PDFs with ColPali
topics.why: RAG-build is a named prod GAP (7x); an OCR-free visual-document pipeline retrieving figures, tables, and charts is the most in-demand net-new RAG build.

topics.topic: Generative Video APIs: Veo and Sora Workflows
topics.why: Text-to-video is now an HTTP API with native synced audio; app-building demand (marketing-ad creation from scripts) needs API-first treatment, not concept-level.

topics.topic: Generative UI: Rendering Tool Calls as Live Components
topics.why: Connecting a tool result to a streamed component is the fastest-maturing agent-frontend pattern powering richer support and app-building agents.

topics.topic: Multi-Model Media Pipelines: Routing and Clip Extension
topics.why: Production teams route by scene type and chain clip-extension for coherent long video, matching the marketing-creative app-building prompts.

topics.topic: The Gen AI Solution Architect Role
topics.why: Explicit prod request for the 'gen AI solution architect' role; maps the end-to-end decision surface (models, RAG, agents, evals, cost, safety) for newcomers.

topics.topic: From Prompting to Context Engineering to Agents
topics.why: Orients learners on the 2026 progression that reframed the field; a conceptual on-ramp connecting prompting, context, tools, and autonomy.

topics.topic: Anatomy of an Agentic Application
topics.why: Grounds the many applied builds (support agents, agentic LMS, signal-scoring agents) in a shared component vocabulary before learners dive into frameworks.
